steps.text: Not all bulbs are the same. Let's compare an old incandescent bulb with a modern LED.
Pick a lamp and switch it on — try the LED.
The incandescent bulb heats a thin wire until it glows — it gives light but wastes a lot as heat. The LED makes light directly, staying cool.
LEDs use far less electricity and last much longer than incandescent bulbs. That's why we've switched to LEDs to save energy.
